description: Create a comprehensive fullstack layer-by-layer cloud shell test script at scripts/fullstack-layer-test.sh that tests all 9 architectural pillars, every endpoint, workflow, event pipeline, and end-to-end user journey. The script must be modular (organized by layer) and produce a detailed report with pass/fail/warn/skip counts.
steps: Create scripts/fullstack-layer-test.sh following the pattern established in scripts/live-deployment-test.sh (color output, pass/fail/warn helpers, perform_request() for timed curl, summary section)

Add script header with usage documentation, environment variable descriptions (BASE_URL, FRONTEND_URL, TEST_JWT_TOKEN, TEST_TURNSTILE_TOKEN, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD, RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET, CRON_SECRET, VERBOSE, SKIP_AUTH_TESTS, SKIP_ADMIN_TESTS), and requirements (bash, curl, jq)

LAYER 0 - Prerequisites & Config: validate that curl and jq are installed, set default URLs, configure performance targets, initialize counters. Add a --dry-run flag that validates script syntax without executing tests.

LAYER 1 - Frontend (P1 Cloudflare): Test frontend page load at FRONTEND_URL with TTFB/compression/security headers checks. Test /robots.txt. Test static asset caching (/assets/ path for Cache-Control: immutable). Test that frontend returns proper HTML with meta tags.

LAYER 2 - Edge Worker (P1 Cloudflare Workers): Test /health endpoint (edge-level health with backend_reachable field). Test /health/full (aggregated edge+backend status). Test CORS preflight (OPTIONS /api/v1/chat with Origin header, validate Access-Control-Allow-Origin). Test security headers (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Strict-Transport-Security, CSP). Test bot detection tagging (send request with bot User-Agent, verify not blocked but X-Bot-Detected set). Test rate limit headers presence on chat endpoints.

LAYER 3 - Backend Health (P2 Cloud Run + P4 MongoDB + P5 Redis): Test GET /health (basic 200). Test GET /health/deep (checks MongoDB, Redis, Vertex Search, Vertex AI status - parse JSON response for individual service statuses). Test GET /health/circuit-breakers (verify vertex_ai, sarvam_ai, vertex_search states).

LAYER 4 - Authentication (JWT Flow): Test POST /api/v1/auth/signup with valid body (expect 200 or 400 if email exists). Test POST /api/v1/auth/login with invalid body (expect 422 validation error). Test POST /api/v1/auth/login with wrong credentials (expect 401). If ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD set, test login and capture JWT token for subsequent tests. Test POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with invalid token (expect 401). Test POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password (expect 200 regardless of email existence). Test that rate limiting returns 429 after too many login attempts (optional, only if STRESS_TEST=1).

LAYER 5 - Chat Endpoints (P6 Vertex AI + P7 Sarvam AI): Test POST /api/v1/chat/ (non-streaming) without auth (expect 200 for anon or 429 if rate limited). Test POST /api/v1/chat/stream (SSE) without auth - check that endpoint responds with correct content-type text/event-stream or 429. If JWT available: test English chat with auth (expect 200, validate response JSON has response/model_used/latency_ms/sources fields). If JWT available: test Assamese chat with lang=as (validate routing to Sarvam). Test POST /api/v1/chat/stream with auth - validate SSE format (data: {"text":...,"done":false} chunks). Test GET /api/v1/chat/history (auth required, expect 200 with chats array). Test GET /api/v1/chat/conversations (legacy alias, should return same format).

LAYER 6 - RAG / Hybrid Search (P3 Vertex AI Search): Test chat response includes sources array when RAG context is available. Test that context_chunks in response have doc_id/title/score/url fields. Validate that search circuit breaker is not open (from /health/circuit-breakers).

LAYER 7 - Content & Knowledge (P4 MongoDB): Test GET /api/v1/content/library-bundle (public, no auth, expect 200 with boards array). Test GET /api/v1/content/library-bundle?slim=1 (slimmer response). Test GET /api/v1/content/render/{board}/{class}/{subject}/{chapter} (expect 200 HTML or 404). Test GET /api/v1/content/{slug} (knowledge object by slug). Test GET /api/v1/content/subject/{board}/{class}/{subject} (list chapters).

LAYER 8 - Subscription & Payments (P8 Razorpay): Test GET /api/v1/subscription/plans (public, no auth, expect 200 with plans array containing free+pro). Test GET /api/v1/subscription/status (auth required, expect 200 with tier/status/limit). Test POST /api/v1/payments/create-order with auth (expect 503 if Razorpay not configured, or 200 with order_id). Test POST /api/v1/payments/verify with invalid signature (expect 400). Test GET /api/v1/payments/history (auth required). Test POST /api/v1/payments/recover (auth required). Test POST /api/v1/payments/credit-topup (auth required, expect 503 or 200).

LAYER 9 - Webhook Pipeline (P8 Razorpay): Test POST /api/webhooks/razorpay without signature (expect 400). Test with invalid signature (expect 400). If RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET set: test with valid HMAC signature and subscription.charged event payload (validate 200 response). Test idempotency (same event_id should return {status: duplicate}).

LAYER 10 - Conversations API: Test GET /api/v1/conversations (auth required, list). Test GET /api/v1/conversations/anon with x-anon-id header (expect 200 with conversations array). Test invalid anon-id format (expect 400). Test PATCH /api/v1/conversations/{id} with auth (title update). Test DELETE /api/v1/conversations/{id}.
LAYER 11 - Feedback: Test POST /api/v1/chat/feedback/ with auth (submit rating, expect 200 with status:ok). Test GET /api/v1/chat/feedback/stats (auth required, expect stats array).

LAYER 12 - Admin Endpoints: If admin JWT available: Test GET /api/v1/admin/dashboard (expect 200). Test admin endpoints return 401/403 without admin token. Test a sample of admin routes: /api/v1/admin/users, /api/v1/admin/analytics, /api/v1/admin/content, /api/v1/admin/settings.
LAYER 13 - SEO & Indexing: Test GET /api/v1/seo/sitemap.xml (expect 200 with XML content). Test GET /api/v1/seo/sitemap-index.xml. Test POST /api/v1/indexnow/submit (expect 401 or proper response).

LAYER 14 - Education Endpoints (Coming Soon): Test GET /api/v1/edu/quiz/{subject} (expect 501). Test GET /api/v1/edu/notes/{subject} (expect 501). Test GET /api/v1/edu/flashcards/{subject} (expect 501).

LAYER 15 - Rate Limiting (P5 Upstash Redis via Edge): Test that chat endpoints include X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset headers. If STRESS_TEST=1: send rapid requests and verify 429 is returned after limit exceeded.

LAYER 16 - Streaming & SSE Validation: If JWT available: test streaming endpoint and validate that response contains multiple data: lines, that the final event has done:true with latency_ms/model/lang fields, and validate proper SSE format.

LAYER 17 - End-to-End Workflows: Workflow 1 (New User Journey): signup -> login -> chat -> get history -> submit feedback. Workflow 2 (Subscription Flow): login -> get plans -> check status -> create order (if Razorpay configured). Workflow 3 (Anonymous User): chat without auth -> get anon history with x-anon-id -> verify conversation listed. Workflow 4 (Content Discovery): library-bundle -> pick first chapter -> render content page.

LAYER 18 - Cross-Cutting Concerns: Test that all API responses include X-Request-ID header. Test X-API-Version header. Test that CORS allows the configured frontend origin. Test that mutating requests from wrong origin return 403 (CSRF protection). Test that /api/health redirects to /health (301).

Add comprehensive SUMMARY section at the end: total tests, passed (green), failed (red), warnings (yellow), skipped (blue). Include section-by-section breakdown. Export results to JSON file (fullstack-test-results.json) if EXPORT_JSON=1. Exit with code 0 if no critical failures, 1 otherwise.
Add --help flag that prints usage and all environment variables. Add --layer N flag to run only a specific layer. Add --quick flag that skips stress tests and optional layers.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/fullstack-layer-test.sh exists, is executable (chmod +x), and passes bash -n syntax check
Running with --dry-run or --help produces documentation output without making any HTTP requests
Script tests all 9 architectural pillars across 18 layers

Script includes at least 60+ individual test assertions covering: health, auth, chat, RAG, content, subscriptions, payments, webhooks, conversations, feedback, admin, SEO, education, rate limiting, streaming, end-to-end workflows, and cross-cutting concerns
Script follows the same patterns as live-deployment-test.sh (colored output, pass/fail/warn, perform_request helper, summary)
All endpoints from apps/backend/app/main.py router registrations are covered by at least one test
End-to-end workflows chain multiple API calls together validating real user journeys
Script is configurable via environment variables for different deployment targets (production, staging, local)
Script exits with code 0 on success, 1 on critical failures
verification: Run: bash -n scripts/fullstack-layer-test.sh (syntax validation - must exit 0)
Run: bash scripts/fullstack-layer-test.sh --help (must print usage without errors)
Run: bash scripts/fullstack-layer-test.sh --dry-run (must validate configuration without HTTP calls)
Verify the script has proper shebang (#!/usr/bin/env bash) and set -euo pipefail
Count test assertions: grep -c 'pass\|fail\|warn' scripts/fullstack-layer-test.sh should show 60+ test result calls
findings: Script created with 183+ test assertions across 18 layers. All verification passes: bash -n (syntax), --help (usage docs), --dry-run (no HTTP calls). openssl not available in sandbox but script handles gracefully with skip. Live API tests confirmed working for layers 0, 3, 14.
